pt.title: Ver os anúncios de todos os clientes do Meta Ads
pt.tagline: Liste campanhas, conjuntos e anúncios do Meta Ads de todos os seus clientes numa só chamada, só com a chave do merchant e filtros por cliente.
pt.intro: Três rotas em /merchants/ads dão o panorama de campanhas, conjuntos e anúncios de todos os seus clientes, só com o token do merchant, sem x-customer-token. Você monitora a base inteira numa chamada, sem percorrer cliente por cliente e sem implementar a API da Meta.
can: Listar campanhas, conjuntos e anúncios de todos os clientes com GET /merchants/ads/campaigns, /merchants/ads/adsets e /merchants/ads.
Restringir a um cliente com customer ou a uma conta com customer_integration.
Filtrar por status e por effective_status, como disapproved, with_issues ou pending_review.
Identificar o dono de cada objeto pelos campos customer_uuid e customer_integration_uuid.
Incluir os apagados com include_deleted=true e paginar com page e per_page.
rules: Essas rotas usam só Authorization: Bearer. Não levam x-customer-token, e customer e customer_integration são filtros, nunca credencial.
Mostram o que o Connect guarda: o que ele criou ou já escreveu nas contas. Uma conta com campanhas antigas só aparece depois da primeira escrita pelo Connect.
Os dados são o último estado conhecido, com synced_at. refresh=true relê os objetos da resposta, mas exige customer_integration.
O customer e a conexão informados precisam ser do merchant do token. Com os dois, a conexão precisa ser desse cliente.
per_page vai de 1 a 100 (padrão 15) e a resposta é {data, links, meta}.

useCases.title: Monitorar anúncios reprovados na base inteira
useCases.body: Um SaaS de tráfego lista com effective_status=disapproved e avisa cada cliente afetado, sem consultar conta por conta.

useCases.title: Visão do gestor numa agência
useCases.body: Uma agência vê campanhas ativas de todos os clientes numa única tela, filtrando por cliente quando precisa aprofundar.

useCases.title: Agente de IA de suporte
useCases.body: Um agente recebe o pedido de um cliente, filtra por customer e responde o que está ativo, pausado ou com problema.

faq.a: Não. Elas usam só o Bearer do merchant. O cliente e a conexão entram como filtros (customer e customer_integration), e são conferidos contra o seu merchant.
GET /ads/campaigns é de um cliente, com x-customer-token e conexão obrigatória. A rota de /merchants/ads cobre todos os clientes e mostra o que o Connect guarda.
São o último estado conhecido, indicado em synced_at. Para atualizar, use refresh=true junto com customer_integration.

en.title: See all your customers' Meta Ads in one call
en.tagline: List Meta Ads campaigns, ad sets and ads across all your customers in one call, with just the merchant token and filters by customer.
en.intro: Three routes under /merchants/ads give you the overview of campaigns, ad sets and ads across all your customers, with just the merchant token and no x-customer-token. You monitor the whole base in one call, without walking customer by customer and without implementing the Meta API.
can: List campaigns, ad sets and ads of all customers with GET /merchants/ads/campaigns, /merchants/ads/adsets and /merchants/ads.
Narrow to one customer with customer or to one account with customer_integration.
Filter by status and by effective_status, such as disapproved, with_issues or pending_review.
Identify each object's owner through customer_uuid and customer_integration_uuid.
Include deleted ones with include_deleted=true and paginate with page and per_page.
rules: These routes use only Authorization: Bearer. They take no x-customer-token, and customer and customer_integration are filters, never credentials.
They show what Connect stores: what it created or already wrote in the accounts. An account with older campaigns only shows up after the first write through Connect.
The data is the last known state, with synced_at. refresh=true re-reads the response's objects, but requires customer_integration.
The customer and connection you pass must belong to the token's merchant. With both, the connection must belong to that customer.
per_page goes from 1 to 100 (default 15) and the response is {data, links, meta}.

useCases.title: Monitor rejected ads across the base
useCases.body: A traffic SaaS lists with effective_status=disapproved and notifies each affected customer, without querying account by account.

useCases.title: Manager view at an agency
useCases.body: An agency sees every customer's active campaigns on one screen, filtering by customer when it needs to dig in.

useCases.title: Support AI agent
useCases.body: An agent gets a customer's question, filters by customer and answers what is active, paused or having problems.

faq.q: Do I need x-customer-token on these routes?
faq.a: No. They use only the merchant Bearer. The customer and connection come in as filters (customer and customer_integration) and are checked against your merchant.

faq.q: How is this different from GET /ads/campaigns?
faq.a: GET /ads/campaigns is for one customer, with x-customer-token and a required connection. The /merchants/ads route covers all customers and shows what Connect stores.

faq.q: Is the data up to date?
faq.a: It is the last known state, shown in synced_at. To update it, use refresh=true together with customer_integration.

fr.title: Voir les annonces Meta Ads de tous vos clients
fr.tagline: Listez campagnes, ensembles et annonces Meta Ads de tous vos clients en un appel, avec le seul token du merchant et des filtres par client.
fr.intro: Trois routes sous /merchants/ads donnent la vue d'ensemble des campagnes, ensembles et annonces de tous vos clients, avec le seul token du merchant et sans x-customer-token. Vous surveillez toute la base en un appel, sans parcourir client par client et sans implémenter l'API Meta.
can: Lister campagnes, ensembles et annonces de tous les clients avec GET /merchants/ads/campaigns, /merchants/ads/adsets et /merchants/ads.
Restreindre à un client avec customer ou à un compte avec customer_integration.
Filtrer par status et par effective_status, comme disapproved, with_issues ou pending_review.
Identifier le propriétaire de chaque objet via customer_uuid et customer_integration_uuid.
Inclure les supprimés avec include_deleted=true et paginer avec page et per_page.
rules: Ces routes n'utilisent que Authorization: Bearer. Pas de x-customer-token, et customer et customer_integration sont des filtres, jamais un identifiant.
Elles montrent ce que Connect stocke : ce qu'il a créé ou déjà écrit dans les comptes. Un compte avec d'anciennes campagnes n'apparaît qu'après la première écriture via Connect.
Les données sont le dernier état connu, avec synced_at. refresh=true relit les objets de la réponse, mais exige customer_integration.
Le customer et la connexion fournis doivent appartenir au merchant du token. Avec les deux, la connexion doit appartenir à ce client.
per_page va de 1 à 100 (15 par défaut) et la réponse est {data, links, meta}.

faq.q: Ai-je besoin de x-customer-token sur ces routes ?
faq.a: Non. Elles n'utilisent que le Bearer du merchant. Le client et la connexion sont des filtres (customer et customer_integration), vérifiés par rapport à votre merchant.

faq.q: En quoi est-ce différent de GET /ads/campaigns ?
faq.a: GET /ads/campaigns concerne un client, avec x-customer-token et une connexion obligatoire. La route /merchants/ads couvre tous les clients et montre ce que Connect stocke.
C'est le dernier état connu, indiqué dans synced_at. Pour le mettre à jour, utilisez refresh=true avec customer_integration.
